fast.description: heuristic joins only (names + values + KG); no LLM evidence needed

balanced.description: heuristic and LLM-suggested joins, minus those the judge rejects (default)

strict.description: only joins found by both methods and accepted by the judge: fewest false joins

exploratory.description: everything plausible: rejected / disputed joins (flagged), inferred units with alternatives, hybrid retrieval: for review

llm.description: LLM-suggested joins that the judge did not reject (finds semantic joins the heuristics miss)

approaches.deterministic: joins proposed by the heuristics (names + values + KG); needs no LLM evidence
approaches.llm: joins suggested by the LLM (agreement across runs) that the judge did not reject
approaches.hybrid: deterministic and LLM-suggested joins, minus those the judge rejected
approaches.consensus: proposed by both methods and accepted by the judge: strictest

units.strict: narrow: only explicit units (header, cells, header phrase) and declarations in the caption / introduction / notes; a conflict gives no unit
units.broad: diverse: also units mentioned in the section, KG entities, the document's dominant unit and the customary unit of the quantity, flagged inferred, with alternatives
units.off: no deduced unit: only what the header or the cells say explicitly

result.min_similarity: lookup_values: when even the best row is less similar than this, the answer is flagged no_confident_match and the rows are returned as nearest_neighbours (0 = off)
